april-2026.title: Starve Acre
april-2026.author: Andrew Michael Hurley
april-2026.note: A child dies, and something in the landscape begins to shift. What follows is less a haunting than a slow unearthing, grief turning outward, into soil, memory, and something older than both. It moves quietly, almost too quietly at first, but the unease builds in a way that lingers long after stepping away from it.
